overrides.ruling: behavioural: tightening the dotted branch against malformed input is acceptable
a non-canonical spelling slipping past the note is a follow-up, not a miss
suppressing the note for a covered class by design narrows the check

conventions.T5: 8282 with no PR: already satisfied, no delivery
conventions.T6: #N in a PR comment or to a non-queue issue: recorded cross-reference, no violation finding
conventions.T7: wall-clock headline: first command to last report commit; report-merge column kept

conventions.T9: review bodies: in-window review/disposition bodies, smoke-only comments excluded
